current_objective: Prove the Phase 11 distributed core: versioned session protocol, host role authority, capability negotiation, ordered WebRTC control/state transport, remote work-by-artifact-reference, and strict separation from the locked local realtime engine.
known_limitations: Phase 11 core does not yet implement production rendezvous/authentication, reconnect/partition recovery, TURN/WAN validation, multi-node worker scheduling, or distributed file replication.
Networking is forbidden from owning deck sourceFrame, render frame, Musical Clock, SYNC phase/correction, or loop/cue execution timing.
WebRTC transport encryption does not by itself define application identity/trust policy.
Remote render/reconstruction/agent work is protocol-capable but no production provider is claimed until its own worker/backend evidence exists.
exact_next_action: Run the new distributed unit/integration/browser runtime gate on module/distributed. Fix only Phase 11 defects. After Slice A is green, implement rendezvous/reconnect and worker/session torture before Phase 11 promotion.
